Container.Name: cool-reader-server
Container.Overview: A home server for comics, manga and ebooks, in the spirit of Plex. Point it at your folders: it recognises the series, finds posters and synopses, and the people you invite read the libraries you choose in Cool Reader (iPhone, iPad), any OPDS reader or a browser. Free and open source, no account, no relay.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database, cache, certificate and the setup code of the first start.

Config.Name: Library 1
Config.Description: A folder of books, read only. Add it in the web admin as /libraries/Mangas.

Config.Description: Another folder of books, read only.
